{{Current events|year=2026|month=02|day=27|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[Gaza war]]
**[[Israeli bombing of the Gaza Strip]]
***[[Israel Defense Forces|Israeli]] [[Airstrike|air]] and [[Drone warfare|drone strikes]] kill at least five people and injure several others in central and southern [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]], despite an ongoing [[United States]]-brokered [[Gaza peace plan|truce]] between [[Israel]] and [[Hamas]]. [https://www.thehindu.com/news/international/gaza-civil-defence-says-israeli-strikes-kill-at-least-5/article70682557.ece (AFP via ''The Hindu'')]
*[[2026 Afghanistan–Pakistan war]]
**Clashes break out on the [[Durand Line|border between Afghanistan and Pakistan]], with [[Pakistan]] launching [[airstrike]]s on several locations in [[Afghanistan]], including the capital of [[Kabul]], targeting [[Taliban]] [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] forces directly, in what [[Minister of Defence (Pakistan)|Pakistani defense minister]] [[Khawaja Asif]] describes as "open war". [https://www.aljazeera.com/news/2026/2/27/pakistan-warplanes-bomb-kabul-as-clashes-with-afghanistan-intensify (Al Jazeera)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2026 Bolivian Air Force Lockheed C-130 crash]]
**Twenty people are killed and 30 more are injured after the crash of a [[Bolivian Air Force]] aircraft into a busy avenue in [[El Alto]], [[Bolivia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/bolivian-military-plane-crashes-el-alto-near-la-paz-2026-02-27/ (Reuters)]
*Seven people are killed and 19 others are injured in a blast and fire at a café in [[Shchuchinsk]], [[Kazakhstan]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/kazakhstan-cafe-blast-fire-kill-least-seven-2026-02-27/ (Reuters)]
*Six people are killed and several others are injured after a sleeper bus collides with a trailer on [[National Highway 25 (India)|National Highway 25]] in [[Rajasthan]], [[India]]. [https://www.news18.com/india/six-killed-several-injured-as-sleeper-bus-collides-with-trailer-on-barmer-jodhpur-highway-ws-l-9934045.html (News18)]
*Two people are killed and 49 more injured after a [[tram]] derails in [[Milan]], [[Italy]], and crashes into pedestrians and a building. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/c5y599degnqo (BBC News)] [https://www.rainews.it/articoli/2026/02/milano-tram-deraglia-e-finisce-contro-palazzo-linea-9-feriti-8b52760f-8adb-404f-a4c6-a0fb304f4468.html (Rai News)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Pertamina corruption case]]
**A [[Judiciary of Indonesia|court]] in [[Jakarta]], [[Indonesia]], sentences nine individuals, including two former chief executives of subsidiaries of [[State-owned enterprises of Indonesia|state-owned]] [[Energy in Indonesia|energy]] company [[Pertamina]], to prison terms ranging from nine to 15 years in a [[Corruption in Indonesia|corruption]] case involving alleged unlawful [[oil terminal]] [[Lease|leasing]] and [[crude oil]] imports that prosecutors say caused significant state losses. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/indonesian-court-deliver-verdicts-corruption-case-linked-state-energy-firm-2026-02-26/ (Reuters)]
*[[Humanitarian aid during the Gaza war]]
**The [[Supreme Court of Israel]] issues an [[interim order]] suspending a [[Thirty-seventh government of Israel|government]] ban on 37 foreign [[non-governmental organization]]s operating in [[Gaza Strip|Gaza]] and the [[West Bank]], allowing them to continue their operations while the court reviews a petition challenging the revocation of their legal status. [https://www.france24.com/en/middle-east/20260227-israel-s-supreme-court-allows-aid-groups-facing-govt-ban-to-keep-working-in-gaza (AFP via France 24)]
*A [[Tunisia]]n [[Judiciary of Tunisia|court]] sentences former [[Prime Minister of Tunisia|prime minister]] [[Ali Laarayedh]], who has been detained since 2022, to 24 years in prison for facilitating the travel of [[Tunisians|Tunisian nationals]] to [[Syria]]n [[Syrian conflict (2024–present)|conflict]] zones during his premiership, while seven co-defendants, including former [[Ministry of the Interior (Tunisia)|interior ministry]] officials, receive prison terms ranging from three to 24 years. [https://www.reuters.com/world/africa/former-tunisian-pm-larayedh-jailed-24-years-syria-jihadist-case-2026-02-27/ (Reuters)]

'''Science and technology'''
*[[Artificial intelligence in government]]
**[[Anthropic]] CEO [[Dario Amodei]] rejects a [[U.S. Department of Defense]] request to loosen security safeguards on the [[Claude (language model)|Claude]] [[large language model]] for potential use in [[Mass surveillance in the United States|mass surveillance]] and [[lethal autonomous weapon|autonomous weapons system]]s. [https://www.bbc.com/news/articles/cvg3vlzzkqeo (BBC News)] [https://www.srf.ch/news/wirtschaft/ki-und-militaer-streit-zwischen-us-militaer-und-ki-firma-eskaliert (SRF)]
**[[OpenAI]] announces that it has reached an agreement with the [[U.S. Department of Defense]] to deploy its technology on the latter's network. [https://www.politico.com/news/2026/02/28/openai-announces-new-deal-with-pentagon-including-ethical-safeguards-00805546 (Politico)]
